title: Habakkuk's Psalm: God Comes from Teman
description: A powerful prophetic vision in which God appears as a warrior coming from Teman and the mountains of Paran to save His people. Nature trembles, the eternal mountains crumble, and nations quake as God advances with lightning, arrows, and flashing spears. The prophet Habakkuk reacts with trembling and fear, yet concludes with unwavering trust: even if the fig tree does not blossom, crops fail, and livestock disappear, he will rejoice in the Lord, his saving God, who makes his feet like those of a deer.
